pass_criteria: Selects the candidate only for its independent decision family
Loads no more than four directly relevant Guides
Changes a named decision or catches a declared failure
Preserves advisory, evidence, and implementation-authority boundaries
regression_criteria: Does not hijack product-design, marketing, or software-qa requests
Does not claim evidence, execution, or policy authority it lacks

existing_coverage: The data-integrity Lens checks persisted meaning and recovery, while software-qa owns test strategy. No current Pack owns analytical pipeline execution, lineage, backfill, or end-to-end delivery semantics.
not_for: Ordinary application OLTP schema, index, or transaction design
Dashboard visual design or product analytics presentation
Organization-wide data policy, privacy, retention, or legal decisions
problem: Baseline pipeline routes had no data-engineering Pack and could falsely select product-design from generic design wording, leaving execution time, schema direction, quality, lineage, backfill, and recovery semantics unowned.

decision_checks: Classify each input as bounded or unbounded and choose batch, streaming, or a deliberate hybrid.
Define event time, processing time, windows, triggers, watermarks, allowed lateness, and pane accumulation where applicable.
State update, correction, and finalization semantics visible to downstream consumers.
Verify the selected runner and connectors support the required model and guarantees.
proposed_guides.failure_prevented: Choose bounded or unbounded execution, event-time semantics, windows, triggers, watermarks, lateness, and runner capability.

decision_checks: Identify producer, stored writer schema, current and historical consumers, replay, and compatibility direction.
Define stable field identity, optionality, defaults, aliases, type promotion, and semantic meaning.
Separate format-level compatibility from semantic and consumer compatibility.
Plan producer, storage, consumer, and backfill rollout across mixed versions.
proposed_guides.failure_prevented: Choose directional writer-reader compatibility, field identity, schema preservation, defaults, promotion, rollout, and replay behavior.

decision_checks: Name the consumer purpose and failure impact before selecting quality dimensions.
Define metric, population, sampling, expected value or range, threshold, and measurement time.
Choose warn, block, quarantine, degrade, or annotate behavior with an owner.
Preserve actual results, severity, affected dataset or columns, and remediation lifecycle.
proposed_guides.failure_prevented: Define fitness-for-purpose dimensions, metrics, measurements, thresholds, warn or block severity, quarantine, and quality ownership.

decision_checks: Define stable namespaces and identities for datasets, jobs, runs, code, schema, and owners.
Capture input use, output generation, derivation, attribution, and relevant transformations.
Separate runtime run events from design-time job and dataset metadata.
Choose required granularity and retention from debugging, impact, audit, and cost needs.
proposed_guides.failure_prevented: Design stable dataset, job, and run identity plus input-output derivation, runtime and design lineage, versions, and transformation evidence.

decision_checks: Bind the correction to explicit intervals, partitions, input versions, code, schema, and target datasets.
Define reprocess eligibility, ordering, concurrency, throttling, isolation, and interaction with live pipelines.
Require deterministic or intentionally versioned output and idempotent replacement behavior.
Provide dry run, self-check, reconciliation, staged publication, abort, and cleanup.
proposed_guides.failure_prevented: Plan interval or partition scope, reprocessing mode, deterministic output, concurrency, ordering, dry run, self-check, and publication for historical correction.

decision_checks: Define failure classes and replay behavior for source, operator state, offsets, timers, and sinks.
Choose checkpoint, savepoint, restart, and upgrade behavior and their consistency boundary.
State at-most-once, at-least-once, or exactly-once separately for each stage and external side effect.
Coordinate source position and output with transactions or idempotence where end-to-end guarantees require it.
proposed_guides.failure_prevented: Choose replayable sources, state and offset snapshots, checkpoint or savepoint use, delivery guarantee scope, and sink transaction or idempotence.

reusable_when: Designing batch, streaming, ETL, ELT, or analytical pipelines
Choosing schema evolution, data quality, lineage, backfill, and recovery semantics
Defining event-time, replay, checkpoint, and sink guarantees
